x-semantic-rules: Client identity and timestamps are not authorization.
EDIT cannot change target date, change kind or entity; create a new proposal for new scope.
Expiry, overlaps and permission scope require backend semantic checks.
Mutating browser endpoints require same-origin and CSRF protection.
Keep original source data and Yext schema unchanged.
Source record IDs/timestamps in fixtures are illustrative; load actual evidence in implementation.
